blurb: Marian Banquet Hall, also referred to as the Riverton KC Hall, was built in Riverton, Illinois by the Marian Council Knights of Columbus. The Council has been in existence for 60+ years and has occupied property on the south side of Riverton for most of its history. The property is located adjacent to Riverton’s Wheeland Park on the Sangamon River.
